title: Service Level Optimization & SLA Drift Detection
thesis: Snowflake ingests real-time operational metrics via Kinesis, detects SLA drift with ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION, predicts breaches, and triggers automated remediation via EventBridge-integrated Task Graphs — proactive, not reactive

talking_points: Two hundred SLA metrics monitored in real-time across 42 client accounts.
Eight accounts showing anomalous drift — projected penalty exposure ₱34M this quarter.
Staffing gap of 127 FTEs across graveyard shifts this week.
tabs.call_out: ₱34M penalty exposure — 8 accounts drifting toward breach

transition.line: Let's see which specific metrics are degrading and why.

talking_points: ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flagged FinServ account AHT drifting up — 4.2 min vs 3.5 min target.
Drift started Tuesday night shift — correlates with 3 senior agents calling in sick.
Without detection, this would breach SLA by Friday — ₱8.5M penalty clause.
show: Show AHT timeseries with anomaly markers
Point at staffing gap on Tuesday
tabs.call_out: Drift detected 72 hours before breach — time to act

transition.line: Early detection means early intervention. Let's look at staffing.

talking_points: Staffing gap analysis shows 127 FTEs needed across 3 sites for this week.
Task Graph auto-triggered: reallocated 45 agents from low-volume queues within 2 hours.
Post-remediation: AHT back to 3.6 min — within SLA tolerance.
show: Show staffing heatmap by shift and site
tabs.call_out: Automated remediation saved ₱8.5M in penalties — 2 hours, no manager intervention

transition.line: Let the SVP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Eduardo asks: 'What's our total penalty exposure for Q4?'
Cortex Analyst: ₱34M across 8 accounts if trends continue.
Follow-up: 'Which metric is most at risk for FinServ?' — AHT, 72 hours to breach.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + contract search

talking_points: Kinesis → Snowpipe Streaming → Dynamic Tables → ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION → Task Graphs → remediation.
End-to-end latency: 15 minutes from metric capture to anomaly alert.
Replaces CloudWatch + SageMaker + EventBridge + Step Functions with native Snowflake.

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for BPO service level management.
